description: A monochrome 84x48 pixel LCD (PCD8544 controller) with an SPI-style interface.
how_to_use: VCC/GND power, BL controls the backlight. RST/CE/DC/DIN/CLK are the control/data/clock lines the microcontroller drives — an SPI-style protocol, but named DIN/CLK rather than MOSI/SCK, so NOT recognized by (or protected by) this project's SPI-bus mechanism, which only matches the exact names MOSI/MISO/SCK/DO/DI. Deliberately left without protocol_legs — flag if a lesson ever needs two of these (or a mix with a real-named SPI device) sharing lines.
